issues.description: The script uses a function (Utils.loadModule) that fetches remote code via XMLHttpRequest and executes it using a[a][a](x.responseText), which is equivalent to eval(). This allows for arbitrary remote code execution.
issues.recommendation: Remove dynamic code execution and only use static, trusted code. Avoid eval or similar constructs.

issues.description: The script uses a[a][a](x.responseText), which is a highly obfuscated way to call the Function constructor (equivalent to eval). This is a strong sign of code obfuscation.
issues.recommendation: Avoid obfuscation and use clear, readable code. Remove dynamic code execution.

issues.description: The script makes network requests to ksw2-moomoo.glitch.me and potentially other arbitrary URLs via Utils.loadModule, which can be used for data exfiltration.
issues.recommendation: Restrict network requests to trusted domains and avoid sending user data.

issues.description: The script requests high-privilege grants such as unsafeWindow, GM_getTabs, GM_getTab, GM_saveTab, but does not use all of them in the visible code. This is a sign of permission overreach.
issues.recommendation: Only request the minimum necessary permissions.

issues.description: The script loads third-party libraries via @require from GreasyFork and CDN (jQuery), but does not pin versions with hashes, exposing to supply chain risks.
issues.recommendation: Pin dependencies to specific versions and use trusted CDNs with integrity hashes.

issues.description: The script uses innerHTML/outerHTML in some modules (not fully visible in the snippet), and the code structure suggests possible direct DOM manipulation with user input, which may lead to DOM XSS.
issues.recommendation: Sanitize all user input before inserting into the DOM.
